subject: Redwood demo request — ShopWise search & embeddings fit
messages:
From: Emma Liu <emma@shopwise.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-22T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Demo request: evaluating embeddings + reranking for search

Hi Priyom —

We signed up for Redwood yesterday (trial) and I landed on your docs about embeddings and reranking. Our use case is product search relevance for ShopWise (retail marketplace). I wanted to book a quick demo to see latency/cost tradeoffs and what a pilot would look like.

A few quick context points:
- Traffic: ~120k monthly unique users, peak concurrent searches ~60 TPS during promos.
- Current infra: ElasticSearch + custom reranker, considering moving heavy embedding work off-host to reduce load.
- Timeline: interested in a 6–8 week pilot; procurement in September.

Can you share availability? PST morning slots are best for us.

Thanks,
Emma
Lead Product Manager, Search
ShopWise
From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Liu <emma@shopwise.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-22T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Demo request: evaluating embeddings + reranking for search

Hi Emma —

Thanks for signing up and for the helpful context. I can walk you through a short live demo focused on: embeddings generation latency, a reranking flow (prefix caching + batch inference), and pilot success criteria. Ben (cc'd) runs our pilot engagements and can lock a time.

Before we schedule, two quick qualification questions so we make the call productive:
1) Which model latency target matters most — median 95ms/token or p95 end-to-end for query+rerank?
2) Do you need results to stay in your VPC for the pilot (Private) or is hosted API OK for initial test?
3) Are embeddings stored centrally (one vector per SKU) or generated per-query (dynamic attributes)?
4) Any SSO/SCIM requirement for trial users?

If hosted API is fine, Ben can propose some PST morning slots this week.

Cheers,
Priyom
SDR, Redwood Inference
From: Emma Liu <emma@shopwise.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>
Cc: ShopWise Support <support@shopwise.com>
Date: 2026-08-23T08:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Demo request: evaluating embeddings + reranking for search

Hi Priyom —

Great questions — answers below:  
1) End-to-end p95 for query+rerank is the main SLA target; we'd like p95 < 300ms for the pilot (fast UI requirements).
2) Hosted API is OK for the pilot; long-term we may need Private for PII/product-supplier data.
3) Embeddings: generally one vector per SKU (~1.6M SKUs), but we also compute small ad-hoc attribute vectors for promos (~30% of queries).
4) SSO: not mandatory for the first pilot, but we prefer SSO-ready flows.

Also attached a quick pilot_scope_template.xlsx with our expected query mix and throughput. If you can propose two PST morning slots (30 mins) this week or early next, that'd be ideal — we prefer 9:00–11:30am PT.

Thanks,
Emma
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Liu <emma@shopwise.com>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-24T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Demo request: evaluating embeddings + reranking for search

Hi Emma —

Thanks for the details — very helpful. I reviewed the attachment and sketched a short 30-minute agenda:
- 5 min: objectives & success criteria (p95 < 300ms, cost per 1k queries)
- 10 min: demo of hosted inference path, batching + prefix cache flow for reranking
- 10 min: pilot plan (data ingestion, volume ramp, monitoring & evals)
- 5 min: next steps / procurement checklist

Proposed slots (PT mornings):
- Tue 2026-08-25, 9:30–10:00am PT
- Wed 2026-08-26, 10:00–10:30am PT

If either works, I'll send a calendar invite + brief pilot one-pager (attachment) and a Cal link to pick alternate times: https://cal.com/redwood/30min?owner=ben.carter

Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
